Situation Report — Day 27

  • No active public sirens reported in the last 2 hours.
  • Pause on energy strikes: U.S. announced a second 10-day pause (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET) citing an "Iranian government request" and progress in talks. Iran denies direct talks. Previous 5-day pause was violated within hours by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Air campaign & airspace: Regional airports closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Flight scans: 765 aircraft currently tracked; 3 military aircraft (RCH260, RCH264, CNV5402) active earlier. Major regional airspace disruption continues.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah active daily. Continued missile/rocket exchanges reported region-wide (routine in last 48 hrs).
  • Cyber: One high-severity cyber incident detected in past 2 hours. Details unconfirmed; potential targeting of infrastructure or comms.
  • Intelligence / Targeting concerns: U.S. officials reportedly feared Israel might target Iranian negotiators during talks (reported by NYT/Ynet). Raises risk to diplomatic channels and escalatory miscalculation.
  • Domestic Israel: Finance and Defense reached deal to add NIS 15 billion to IDF budget. Tactical impact: more sustainment and strike capacity funded.
  • International / Energy: Kuwait will sharply boost crude production in June after the US-Iran arrangements. Iran permitting Hormuz transit for Russia, India, China while restricting others (ongoing).
  • Diplomacy: Pakistan mediating. No confirmed ceasefire talks between Tehran and Washington/Israel.
  • Legal/media: Israeli media watchdog upheld journalist criteria amid Gaza database controversy (operational impact: media scrutiny).
  • 🟢 Good News: Additional NIS 15 billion approved for IDF operations and sustainment.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: הוספת 15 מיליארד ש"ח לתמיכה בפעילות צה"ל.

  • 🟢 Good News: Government secured immediate NIS 15 billion boost for the IDF. Pakistan mediation continues.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

Cyber & Infrastructure

  • Israel: Finance and Defense agreed extra NIS 15 billion for IDF; IDF warns of manpower strain.
